FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) ACT 1984

FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) (COLLECTION OF TOLLS)

(GUTHRIE CORRIDOR EXPRESSWAY) (NO. 2) (AMENDMENT) (NO. 3) ORDER 2015

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 2 of

the Federal Roads (Private Management) Act 1984 [Act 306], the Minister makes the

following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads (Private Management)

(Collection of Tolls) (Guthrie Corridor Expressway) (No. 2) (Amendment) (No. 3)

Order 2015.

 (2) This Order comes into operation on 15 October 2015.

Substitution of First Schedule

2. The Federal Roads (Private Management) (Collection of Tolls) (Guthrie Corridor

Expressway) (No. 2) 2005 [P. U. (A) 298/2005] is amended by substituting for the First

Schedule the following Schedule:

"FIRST SCHEDULE

[subparagraph 2(1)]

4. Taxi 0.90 0.90 0.90

5. Bus 1.40 1.40 1.40

For the purpose of calculating the number of axles and wheels of a vehicle, the axles and

wheels of any trailer towed by the vehicle shall be calculated as part of the axles and

wheels of the vehicle.".

Made 12 October 2015

[KKR/PUU.110-1/7/17; PN(PU2)426/LX]
